mapper.select: SELECT metric_source, monitor_id AS monitorId, metric_name AS metricName, AVG(metric_value) AS avgValue, MIN(metric_value) AS minValue, MAX(metric_value) AS maxValue, COUNT(*) AS countValue FROM ( SELECT 'GENERIC' AS metric_source, ms_monitor_metric_monitor_id AS monitor_id, ms_monitor_metric_metric_name AS metric_name, ms_monitor_metric_metric_value AS metric_value FROM ms_monitor_metric WHERE ms_monitor_metric_collect_time >= #{hourStart} AND ms_monitor_metric_collect_time < #{hourEnd} UNION ALL SELECT 'REDIS' AS metric_source, ms_monitor_redis_metric_monitor_id AS monitor_id, ms_monitor_redis_metric_metric_name AS metric_name, ms_monitor_redis_metric_metric_value AS metric_value FROM ms_monitor_redis_metric WHERE ms_monitor_redis_metric_collect_time >= #{hourStart} AND ms_monitor_redis_metric_collect_time < #{hourEnd} ) metric_points GROUP BY metric_source, monitor_id, metric_name
